glosses: past passive perfective participle of испуга́ть (ispugátʹ)

examples.text: She looked very much frightened of the storm.

He tried to persuade Cicely to stay away from the ball-room for a fourth dance.[…]But she said she must go back, and when they joined the crowd again her partner was haled off with a frightened look to the royal circle, […].

glosses: simple past and past participle of frighten

examples.text: The elephant was frightened by mice.
